It can help you feel more aligned with how you want to present yourself, which can boost confidence and clarity. 3. **Routine and Ritual**: Rituals like this can create a sense of structure and purpose in your morning. They can also be calming, helping you start the day with intention rather than rushing. 4. **Attention to Detail**: If you enjoy the precision of shaving and trimming, it might be a way to channel focus and creativity into something tangible. It sounds like you’ve found a way to make your morning routine meaningful and intentional. If you enjoy it, there’s no reason not to continue—it’s a personal practice that can enhance your sense of readiness and self-assurance. Plus, it’s always a good idea to take care of yourself in ways that feel good to you!
